description: This file is a JSON schema-based API description for the VoiceControl plugin, detailing methods, events, parameters, and responses related to voice control sessions.

methods.name: configureVoice
methods.description: Configures the RDK's voice stack with various URL endpoints and device settings.

methods.name: sendVoiceMessage
methods.description: Sends a message payload to the Voice Server, for transmitting context or ASR blobs.

methods.name: setVoiceInit
methods.description: Sets application metadata in the VOICE INIT message sent to the Voice Server.

methods.name: voiceSessionByText
methods.description: Simulates a voice session using transcription text for QA purposes. Deprecated in favor of 'voiceSessionRequest'.

methods.name: voiceSessionTypes
methods.description: Retrieves the list of supported voice session request types.

methods.name: voiceSessionRequest
methods.description: Requests a voice session with specific parameters, such as transcription or audio file.

methods.name: voiceSessionTerminate
methods.description: Terminates an ongoing voice session based on session ID.

methods.name: voiceSessionAudioStreamStart
methods.description: Starts a new audio stream within an existing voice session.

methods.name: voiceStatus
methods.description: Provides current configuration and status of the voice stack, including URLs and device statuses.
